metadata.description: Curated, dual-format skill collection: installable as a Claude Code plugin marketplace or via `bunx skills`. A full dev pipeline (grill-me -> to-prd -> compass -> heist -> maestro -> parallel-worktrees), a pre-commit quality gate (implementation-review + testing-philosophy + security-audit + wstg), language idioms, plus career/product/reporting/SEO tools.

plugins.name: maestro
plugins.description: Verify parallel feasibility across plans, orchestrate agents in git worktrees, run integration tests, clean up. Deterministic branch names (parallel/<slug>).

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Conductor for the dev pipeline: detects a task's tier (bug / feature / architecture / client), prints the exact chain of sub-skills it will run and skip with reasons, confirms, then drives them in order. Matches ceremony to stakes.

plugins.name: cv-craft
plugins.description: Maintain a canonical master CV in Markdown and produce tailored, ATS-friendly resumes and recruiter-screen prep packs from job descriptions.

plugins.name: write-a-skill
plugins.description: Meta-skill: create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: Deterministic LLM-first SEO audits for websites, blog posts, and GitHub repos. 16 sub-skills, 10 specialist agents, 33 evidence scripts. Adapted from Bhanunamikaze/Agentic-SEO-Skill (originally AgriciDaniel/claude-seo).

plugins.name: wstg-security-testing
plugins.description: Web application security testing via the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG) — 12 categories, ~109 test cases. Four modes: guide a pentest, self-review your app, build/score a coverage checklist, review a diff against WSTG. Methodology from OWASP/wstg. Authorized/defensive use only.

plugins.name: pr-craft
plugins.description: Create a pull request with a structured description (Problem / Root cause / Fix / Test / Out of scope) derived from the diff and conversation. Drives the branch -> commit -> push -> gh pr create flow.

plugins.name: implementation-review
plugins.description: Pre-commit quality gate: seven parallel-subagent checks (plan gaps, use-case coverage, test scenarios, test philosophy, SOLID, Clean Code, security). Runs after /verify, before commit.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: High-confidence security review of a diff, layered on wstg-security-testing. Confidence gate, false-positive precedents, WSTG-ID mapping, and a dependency audit. Reports only concretely exploitable findings.

plugins.name: testing-philosophy
plugins.description: Defines what a good test is: behavior over implementation, the Testing Trophy, and an e2e floor for user-facing features. Stack-agnostic (TS/Rust/Go/Elixir/Python). Kent Dodds, generalized.

plugins.name: parallel-worktrees
plugins.description: Playbook for parallel work across git worktrees: go/no-go, file partitioning, isolation mechanism, integration and cleanup. The plan-optional counterpart to maestro.

plugins.name: to-prd
plugins.description: Synthesize conversation context into a PRD. Writes docs/prds/NNNN-<slug>.md + publishes to GitHub Issues. Includes Glossary section. Adapted from mattpocock/skills.

plugins.name: heist
plugins.description: Turn a settled feature scope into an implementation plan at docs/plans/NNNN-<slug>.md. Crew, sequence (with parallel phases), getaway, payoff. Consumes PRDs + ADRs.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: Multi-mode software engineering coach: architect, advisor, reviewer, refactor, legacy, and explainer workflows. Auto-writes ADRs to docs/adr/.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan or design via relentless interview. Resolves each branch of the decision tree, captures domain vocabulary, emits Design Notes + Glossary block for /to-prd. Adapted from mattpocock/skills.

plugins.name: publish-skill
plugins.description: Publish one of your own skills from ~/.claude/skills to this repo: copy it under skills/<name>/, mint its plugin.json, upsert marketplace.json, and push to main. Idempotent.

plugins.name: brag-doc
plugins.description: Maintain a monthly brag document and roll it up into a promo packet, self-review, or CV material. Lucas Faria's 4-field template + Julia Evans' impact-first categories. Feeds cv-craft.

plugins.name: cagan-check
plugins.description: Apply Marty Cagan (SVPG) + Teresa Torres Continuous Discovery to a dev's workflow: feature kickoff, planning/estimation, discovery calls, PR review. Flags feature-factory smells; green/yellow/red per dimension.

plugins.name: code-craft
plugins.description: Language- and framework-specific best practices and idioms. Reader and reviewer modes. Ships 7 languages + 12 frameworks (TS, Rust, CSS, Tailwind, Dart, Go, Python, React, Next, RN+Expo, Hono, Workers, Astro, Svelte, Drizzle, Supabase, Lambda, Terraform, Flutter).

plugins.name: commit-report
plugins.description: Dual-format commit report (prose + bullets) from recent git activity, tunable to audience (dev / pm / client).

plugins.name: portfolio-sync
plugins.description: Sync the current project into a central project-portfolio Markdown archive. Source data for cv-craft.
